lesson.title: Start With Customer Need, Not Just Shoe Style
lesson.summary: Learn how footwear categories connect to customer need, then use that thinking to spot business opportunities.
lesson.explanation: Shoe business එකේ first mindset එක: මේ shoe එක ලස්සනද කියන එකට වඩා මේක කාටද, මොන use එකකටද, customer එකේ මොන problem එක solve කරනවද කියලා බලන්න. Formal, casual, sports, sandals, school, work/safety සහ comfort footwear වගේ categories demand reason එක අනුව තේරුම් ගන්න.
keyPoints: Category = product style + intended use + target customer.
Good assortment planning starts with customer segments, not random designs.
Every style should have a reason to exist in your stock.

terms.meaning: The job the shoe must do

lesson.buyerTip: Shop එකක shoes බලනකොට price එක විතරක් note කරන්න එපා. Category, material, sole, sizes, customer type, promotion සහ display position එකත් note කරන්න.
lesson.businessAngle: A future shoe shop can win by being very clear about one customer problem rather than trying to sell everything from day one.
lesson.visualFocus: Take photos or notes of 10 different shoe categories in one local store and classify each by customer + use.

marketPulse.title: Sri Lanka footwear industry research starting point
marketPulse.summary: The Sri Lanka Export Development Board maintains a footwear industry resource area covering the local sector and exporters.
marketPulse.whyItMatters: Local manufacturer and exporter networks can be a sourcing and private-label research starting point, not only imported finished shoes.

marketPulse.title: Automation is reshaping footwear production
marketPulse.summary: Reuters reported on sportswear brand On launching a robot-powered factory in South Korea using automated production technology.
marketPulse.whyItMatters: Faster and more automated manufacturing could influence lead times, customization and sourcing options over time.

marketPulse.title: Trade fairs remain useful for supplier discovery
marketPulse.summary: Footwear industry trade events continue to connect buyers with materials, machinery, technology and manufacturing suppliers.
marketPulse.whyItMatters: Learning how to use fairs and supplier events as research tools is important before committing to factories or large orders.

opportunities.title: Comfort-first affordable footwear
opportunities.why: A focused comfort/value offer may be worth testing among customers who stand or walk for long hours.
opportunities.targetCustomer: Office workers and adults who stand/walk for long hours
opportunities.businessModel: Curated retail + online catalogue + fit guidance
opportunities.risk: Customers may say comfort matters but still buy mainly by price or style
opportunities.validation: Interview 20 buyers and test 5–10 styles before large stock

opportunities.title: Small-batch local private-label line
opportunities.why: Sri Lanka has an established footwear manufacturing base, so local small-batch sourcing is worth investigating before assuming importing is the only route.
opportunities.businessModel: Source locally, control spec and branding, sell direct and through selected retailers
opportunities.risk: MOQ, quality consistency and design differentiation
opportunities.validation: Contact 5 manufacturers and compare sample, MOQ and lead-time terms

startupAdvice.title: Build a 30-shoe market observation sheet
startupAdvice.action: Visit 2–3 shoe retailers or browse their online catalogues. Record 30 products: category, target buyer, price, material, sole type, sizes, promotion and what problem each product appears to solve.
startupAdvice.measure: Repeated price bands, categories and features you identify
startupAdvice.successSignal: You can describe 3 possible gaps or crowded product areas using evidence, not guesses

newThinking.title: Fit + Comfort Score instead of only size
newThinking.idea: Create a simple 5-point in-store score for width, cushioning, heel hold, flexibility and weight, then show it on product cards.
newThinking.why: Customers often struggle to compare comfort features between visually similar shoes.
newThinking.test: Score 10 existing shoes and ask 10 people whether the score helps them shortlist faster.

quiz.question: What should come before randomly choosing styles for stock?
A new business opportunity should first be treated as…
options: A reason to buy maximum stock

todayAction.title: 10-Shoe Observation Challenge
todayAction.task: Choose one local or online footwear retailer. Study 10 shoes and record category + target buyer + price + main value proposition.
